result.note: Tested the September 2026 Defence Acquisition Council clearance: its size, indigenous share and terrain focus.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the arms procurement cleared by the Defence Acquisition Council in September 2026:
items: It cleared procurement worth about INR 1.1 trillion.
Roughly 98% of the procurement is to come from Indian manufacturers.
It was weighted toward equipment for moving and fighting across the rough terrain of the China and Pakistan borders.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three are correct. On 8 September 2026 the Defence Acquisition Council cleared about INR 1.1 trillion (USD 11.7 billion), nearly all of it from domestic makers, with a focus on mobility and combat along India's northern and western frontiers.
questions.source: The Defence Acquisition Council cleared about INR 1.1 trillion (USD 11.7 billion) in arms procurement, roughly 98% from Indian manufacturers, weighted toward equipment for moving and fighting across the rough terrain of the China and Pakistan borders.
